purpose: Operator-assisted one-time encoder/distance calibration, followed by motion speed reconciliation.
procedure: Observe stopped telemetry and capture left-wheel count baseline.
With GP21 held, operator manually turns marked left wheel exactly one full revolution; capture end count and calculate wrap-safe delta.
Combine with user-reported right-wheel 31142 -> 33655 observation; check repeatability before applying calibration.
Only after scales are known, prepare a controlled distance trial and reconcile physical speed settings. No network motor commands or automatic powered motion.
expected: Measured/user-reported observations remain distinct; incomplete measurements do not become calibrated constants.

known_observation.source: user-reported manual full revolution; right wheel identity confirmed by user
